measurement_interpretation: Each of the nine contract families was first compiled as its own complete-TU variant. Eight alone were object-identical; correcting angles with an int temporary added a redundant lsl/asr conversion in place of mov.

An ordinary short angle local or nested real GetSubtraction call each preserves the complete object. The short-local/member form is retained. Result narrowing probes failed and are not used; the original cmp return semantics remain unchanged.
Real ApproachLinear overloads also preserve the complete object and are adopted.
The exact genuine ModelAnim::SetAnim probe uses Fix12<int> speed={0x1000} and the existing member. It grows func02111ee0 from0xe4 to0xec and func02111c30 from0x2b0 to0x2b8.
The exact genuine DropShadowRadHeight probe uses separate Fix12<int> radius/depth locals and the existing member. It grows func0211216c from0xd8 to0xec.

Only these valid tested forms failed. No universal compiler-impossibility claim is made. The actual scalar SetAnim definition takes u16 startFrame and DropShadow takes u8 opacity; the retained typed bridges agree with those definitions without rewriting shared member declarations.

func02111ee0 has one incoming module-qualified relocation at021120c0 from void state dispatch func02112080; its result is unused. Void early returns and real UpdatePos preserve all bytes. This is bounded reconstruction evidence, not unique recovery of an original return type.
